quests.title: Calculus Master Final Challenge
quests.description: Master advanced calculus concepts and become a true mathematical expert!

story.introduction: The Mathematical Olympiad Committee has prepared the ultimate calculus challenge! Prove your mastery of advanced mathematical concepts.

steps.title: Integration Mastery Challenge
steps.narrative: The Grandmaster presents you with complex integration problems that test your understanding of various techniques.

problem.question: Evaluate: ∫(x² + 1)/(x³ + 3x + 2) dx
problem.explanation: This requires partial fraction decomposition and knowledge of standard integration formulas.
